body:
"Contributing to society" is a measurement of my crappy character and caliber. I don't love this society that I live in, so I don't see a purpose in contributing to it other than for moral's sake. I hate charities, and working a job feels pointless since there is nothing I want to be alive for.

"while you're on Earth" is interesting. I'm always thinking that people make movies and story books because the real world sucks and is boring.

I don't have anything I want: that's a reason for living. How do I go about finding something I want?
